_comment: Copy to config/orchestrator.json and edit. The orchestrator polls every tick_interval_ms.

stuck._comment_1: Heuristics for detecting agents running but not progressing.
stuck._comment_2: idle_timeout_ms: session alive, no events in this long -> stuck:idle
stuck._comment_3: tool_loop_threshold: same tool+file N times in a row -> stuck:tool_loop
stuck._comment_4: thrashing_window: last N events, no Edit/Write -> stuck:thrashing
stuck._comment_5: stopped_no_changes: Stop fires but ticket never touched a file -> asked-and-returned
stuck._comment_6: re_notify_after_ms: throttle repeat Slack pings for the same stuck reason
stuck._comment_7: whitelist: glob patterns (* wildcard) matched against the ticket id and its labels — tickets that match are never flagged stuck. Use for long research spikes, infra tasks, etc. Examples: 'gh:your-org/your-repo#42', 'long-running', 'research-*'

budget._comment: cost_per_event_usd is a rough proxy — we charge each hook event, not real tokens. Tune based on observed spend.
budget._comment_kill: kill_grace_ms: on halt (killswitch or cap), SIGTERM the spawned agent's process group, then SIGKILL after this many ms if it hasn't exited.

retry._comment: Retry failed spawns with exponential backoff: 5s, 30s, 5min

spawn._comment_2: Default targets `claude -p` headless mode. If your Claude Code CLI uses a different flag, customize here.
spawn._comment_3: Set dry_run:true while testing — logs what would run without actually spawning.

digest._comment_1: Daily rollup. Orchestrator fires once per day at 'time' (local, 24h HH:MM).

slack._comment: Create an incoming webhook in Slack, export the URL to the env var below, then orchestrator will post there.
